$comment: ACM type:style -> the wp-ja-restaurant pattern that renders it, field by field, for the seeder (renderAcm, `${type}:${style}`). Field names are the Joomla ACM field names verbatim, plus the fields tasks/ja-restaurant-wp7/tools/fix-spec.mjs adds. metadata.name is <type>.<field>[.<n>]; the wrapper of a repeated row is <type>.item.<n>. A block is located by name, never by position.

views.$comment: search is com_finder at /explore/j-pages/smart-search on the source; the theme answers that path with its search view (inc/extra.php wp_ja_restaurant_search_request), so the seeder adds no redirect for it.

page-account.$comment: a guest who opens a profile page gets 303 to the Login page, as the source (inc/groups/account.php)

single.$comment: the theme answers an article at its category path, as the source answers it at its menu path (inc/extra.php wp_ja_restaurant_article_route_request)
